contracts.name: PLAYER_INTERACTION_MARKER
contracts.evidence: Actor_PlayerCollisionPass publishes the colliding actor marker and clears it at the start of the next pass; terrain/idle/anchor paths branch on values 0x5E and 0x60.

contracts.name: PLAYER_TERRAIN_PUSH_DOWN_STATE
contracts.evidence: Player_TerrainResponseStateMachine sets the byte for grounded push-down response, uses it to gate action/terrain selection, and clears it on convergence or jump initialization.

contracts.name: PLAYER_TERRAIN_PUSH_UP_STATE
contracts.evidence: Player_TerrainResponseStateMachine sets the byte for grounded push-up response, uses it to gate terrain/action selection, and clears it on convergence or jump initialization.

contracts.name: PLAYER_TERRAIN_RESPONSE_PHASE
contracts.evidence: Collision/terrain response paths arm the latch, locomotion/action selectors gate on it, and Player_TerrainResponseStateMachine clears it as the response converges; the separate signed values -3, -1, 1, and 3 belong to TERRAIN_RESPONSE_TIMER_STATE at 0x00FFF0CC.

contracts.name: PLAYER_TERRAIN_RESPONSE_TIMER
contracts.evidence: Type-0x02/0x08/0x09 collision handlers load 4, Actor_PlayerCollisionPass decrements it once per pass, and Player_TerrainResponseStateMachine tests the nonzero state.

contracts.name: PLAYER_TERRAIN_RESPONSE_LEFT
contracts.evidence: The shared type-0x08/0x09 handler sets the left latch and Actor_PlayerCollisionPass clears it before the terrain state machine consumes it.

contracts.name: PLAYER_TERRAIN_RESPONSE_RIGHT
contracts.evidence: The shared type-0x08/0x09 handler sets the right latch and Actor_PlayerCollisionPass clears it before the terrain state machine consumes it.

contracts.name: PLAYER_TERRAIN_BRAKE_STATE
contracts.evidence: Player_TerrainResponseStateMachine consumes the latch to select PLAYER_ANIM_BRAKE after settled landing; terrain/collision paths clear it.

conclusion: The unnamed player terrain/collision response bytes now have canonical, statically bounded roles without inventing indirect producers or user-facing action names.
